definitions.explanation: A large gathering of people in one place.

examples.japanese: {人込|ひとご}みが{苦手|にがて}です。
{人込|ひとご}みを{避|さ}けて{歩|ある}いた。
{駅前|えきまえ}は{人込|ひとご}みで{賑|にぎ}わっていた。
examples.english: The area in front of the station was bustling with crowds.

notes:
{人込|ひとご}み refers to a dense crowd of people, typically in a busy area like a shopping street, station, or festival. It emphasizes the uncomfortable density rather than the group itself.

WRITING VARIANTS:
Can be written as {人込|ひとご}み, {人混|ひとご}み, or {人|ひと}ごみ. All are common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人込|ひとご}みを{避|さ}ける: to avoid crowds
- {人込|ひとご}みに{紛|まぎ}れる: to disappear into the crowd
- {人込|ひとご}みをかき{分|わ}ける: to push through a crowd
- {人込|ひとご}みの{中|なか}: in the crowd
- {人込|ひとご}みが{苦手|にがて}: to dislike crowds

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {群衆|ぐんしゅう}: crowd, mob (more formal, often in news)
- {人波|ひとなみ}: wave of people (emphasizes flow/movement)
- {雑踏|ざっとう}: throng, hustle and bustle (literary)
- {混雑|こんざつ}: congestion, crowding (broader, includes traffic)
